method.boundary_source: big-endian IMAGE_CE_RUNTIME_FUNCTION records from each derived .pdata block
method.branch_normalized_fingerprint: SHA-256 after clearing PPC b/bl LI and bc BD displacement fields
method.opcode_structure_fingerprint: SHA-256 of primary opcode plus XO for opcodes 19/31/59/63
method.semantic_reference_probe: simple lis/addi and lis/ori address materializations intersected with curated prototype strings present in both images
method.limitation: Phase 1 feasibility only; fingerprints are candidates and do not authorize TU1 renames.

recommended_features: unique raw or branch-normalized PPC fingerprints
CFG verification before accepting non-exact matches
